TESTNET WALLET SUPPORT · TRADING IN DEVELOPMENT
A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curiosity welcome.

Here’s where things stand.

Can I trade with real DOGE today?+

The trading ticket uses illustrative data and never submits an order. You can connect MetaMask, switch to DogeOS Chikyū Testnet, and view your testnet DOGE balance. Deposits, approvals, real trading, and rewards settlement are not enabled.

How will earning in DOGE work?+

DOGE-denominated rewards and an earning experience are part of Vela’s planned DogeOS integration. The yield source, custody model, availability, fees, and reward terms still need to be finalized. The calculator uses your assumptions; it is not an advertised APY or promised return.

What do the AI agents actually do?+

The six roles research market ideas, challenge assumptions, interpret direction, test in paper trading, review promotion evidence, and provide feedback. The flow shown here is illustrative; this website does not run the agents or contact a model provider.

What does the $2 stop budget mean?+

The copied execution core limits every account’s per-position stop trigger loss budget to a maximum of $2, including trading fees, while retaining stricter limits. Stops round inward and account for partial exits. This is a trigger calculation, not a guarantee against slippage, market gaps, or funding charges. New DogeOS execution paths must be tested before activation.

Which wallets can I connect?+

Choose MyDoge Wallet or MetaMask. MyDoge uses the official DogeOS connection flow, including the native wallet when you open Vela inside MyDoge. MetaMask connects through your extension or mobile browser. On DogeOS Chikyū Testnet, Vela can show your address and testnet DOGE balance. Connecting a wallet does not authorize automated trading or move funds.
